aspect: Savings are not a rational act under 40% inflation
description: Holding the currency is a guaranteed loss, so households convert to goods, gold or dollars, or spend. The resulting absence of savings is then read abroad as financial illiteracy.
energy_note: Punished for not saving in a currency that eats itself.

description: Training for a profession, starting a company, having a child, buying a house. All require an assumption of continuity, and the assumption is not available.
energy_note: A life lived in three-month increments.

aspect: Emigration becomes the only plan anyone has
description: When the domestic future is unusable, the entire national conversation reduces to leaving. That is itself a psychological condition affecting people who never go.
energy_note: A country where the only plan is the exit.

aspect: SECONDARY - it hollows out the professional class first
description: Doctors, engineers and academics have the mobility to act on it, so they do. The health system loses the staff at the same time it loses the drugs.
energy_note: The people who could fix it leaving because of it.

description: They were going to marry in 2023 and buy a flat. Then the rial moved again. They are still engaged, still in their parents' houses, aged 33 and 31, and they no longer discuss the date.
